name: @localtaskrepo/lotar
description: A task and project management tool that runs locally and can be synced via repo

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:js && npm run fmt:js:check && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:fmt
scripts.lint:agent: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never; npm run lint:frontend; npx eslint .; npm run fmt:js:check; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --color never -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all --check'
scripts.build:smoke: npm run build:web && cargo build --profile smoke
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ui && npm run test:release && npm run test:hooks
scripts.test:agent: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; npm run test:rust:agent; npm run test:ui:agent; npm run test:release; npm run test:hooks'
scripts.test:ui:agent: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0; vitest run --config view/vitest.config.ts --reporter dot --no-color "$@"' --
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:smoke && vitest run --config smoke/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke:agent: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never; npm run build:smoke; vitest run --config smoke/vitest.config.ts --reporter dot --no-color "$@"' --
scripts.test:smoke:quick:agent: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0; vitest run --config smoke/vitest.config.ts --reporter dot --no-color "$@"' --
scripts.smoke:ui: npm run build:web && bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; LOTAR_WEB_UI_EMBEDDED=0 LOTAR_WEB_UI_PATH="$PWD/target/web" npm run test:smoke:quick'
scripts.coverage:rust: cargo llvm-cov nextest --all-features --no-fail-fast --html --output-dir target/coverage/rust && cargo llvm-cov report --lcov --output-path target/coverage/rust/lcov.info && cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only

author: Ravi Gairola <mallox@pyxzl.net>
